text:
elaine: OK folks — planning sync. I sketched a milestone chain for the Q4 Private rollout. Need a quick dependency map so we can lock the canary date. Who owns model onboarding artifacts and SLA gating?

matt: eng-runtime owns the inference performance gates. we need model quant configs from eng-ml by week 2 or we'll slip kernel tuning.

linh: that'll be tight but doable. i'll push a minimal quant profile by EOW Fri (W1). can we scope the first canary to 8k seq only? less variance.

elaine: yes — canary=v1 8k seq only. broader seq support is in v1.1.

shiv: eng-platform note: infra provisioning for Dedicated pools needs 2 weeks lead once capacity req is final. also networking (VPC peering) requires security review from eng-sre.

anya: eng-sre here — review slot booked Tue W2. please add the compliance checklist to the doc. we'll need KMS integration tested before canary.

nora: customer-success: two enterprise pilots requested Private deployment earlier if we can guarantee isolation and audit logs. They care about KMS + HSM.

tom: sales —Headsup: if we can offer PII redaction and on-prem option in Q4 we have 3 deals that could close. they need rollout by end of month+30.

matt: blockers: kernel tuning depends on exact model shards + vocab layout. @linh can you confirm shard plan? also, we need perf histograms from the eval harness.

linh: shard plan v0 attached to the doc. (uploaded) i can finalize W1. eval histos: i can run a baseline by Mon.

elaine: awesome. i'm adding a short gating checklist in the thread — fill "yes/no/date" next to each.

elaine: ```
Gates for canary (v1):
- model artifacts available: yes/no/date
- quant profile done: yes/no/date
- kernel perf within SLO: yes/no/date
- infra provisioned (Dedicated pool): yes/no/date
- KMS + audit logs tested: yes/no/date
- canary runbooks & rollback: owner/date
- customer pilot signoff (if requested): yes/no/date
```

matt: model artifacts: pending/1956789072 (linh to finalize)

linh: quant profile done: yes/1956789056

shiv: infra provisioned: pending/estimate 2w after capacity req finalization

anya: KMS + audit logs tested: pending/slot Tue W2

nora: customer pilot signoff: potential/depends on KMS and on-prem checklist

elaine: timeline proposal: 
- W1: finalize artifacts + quant profile
- W2: eng-sre review + infra request
- W3: kernel tuning + canary dry-run (internal)
- W4: customer canary + feedback loop
if we hit all gates we can target end-of-quarter canary.

tom: will align with GTM for notices. also prepping contract language for HSM option.

matt: quick ask — can eng-ml drop model with smaller KV size? that would reduce latency and simplify kernel tuning.

linh: yes we can try a trim variant. i'll add it to the eval runs.

elaine: thanks. please update the doc with explicit owners and dates by Friday. i'll consolidate into the milestone tracker and share with execs. :sparkles:

deploy-bot: Scheduled infra review reminder set for 1956790000.

matt: noted. i'll post perf histograms after the baseline run Monday.

elaine: perfect — pinging again Fri for final owner/date matrix. cheers everyone.
